annotations.title: Send feedback to the VCB team

description: Sends private feedback about the Vibe Coding Builders site to the VCB team, as the signed-in member: a bug, an idea, or anything else. Only VCB admins read it; it is not public. The same message within 24 hours returns the first one (replayed: true). Limits: 5 in 10 minutes, 20 a day.

message.description: The feedback, in the member's words.

page_url.description: The vibecoding.builders page it is about, if any (full https link).
